answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 29204 Country: India Title: After hajj, we went to masjid ayesha for jiyaarah only and did not intended to perform Umra. We performed Two rakat namaj and came back . Is there any problem being coming out of Haram(masjid-e-ayesha )before performing Tawaful Wida? After one week we performed Tawaful Wida just before leaving Makka Mukarma. Question: Asslamu Alikum After hajj, we went to masjid ayesha for jiyaarah only and did not intended to perform Umra. We performed Two rakat namaj and came back . Is there any problem being coming out of Haram(masjid-e-ayesha )before performing Tawaful Wida? After one week we performed Tawaful Wida just before leaving Makka Mukarma. Answer ID: 29204 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 167/99/D=1432) The tawaf-e-wida (farewell tawaf) which you performed earlier is enough. No extra tawaf or umrah was wajib due to going to Masjid-e-Ayesha. You did well that you returned after offering two rakah salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
